Fueling Deicing

Recuperación de glicol

The process of collecting used glycol-based de-icing or anti-icing fluids from airport surfaces after application for environmental management and recycling.

Questions and answers

What is Recuperación de glicol?

In this glossary, Recuperación de glicol refers to: The process of collecting used glycol-based de-icing or anti-icing fluids from airport surfaces after application for environmental management and recycling.

How is Recuperación de glicol used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Confirme que los camiones de recuperación de glicol están posicionados antes de iniciar el deshielo para evitar escurrimientos a los drenajes."

Definition
